Return-register/FPU-stack/status side effects are excluded. Converts time*60 before pointer-null guard; signed16 physical emitter link; physical byte2f1 exactly4 chooses clockB otherwise clockA. Type7 counter products use binary32-spilled integerticks and fresh physical50/54 reads; first low16 counter store may alias the second coefficient.
